Function Documentation

HxResult HxColorDialog ( const char *  pTitle,
HxColor_t *  pColor,
HxColorDialogButtonType_t *  pButton 
)

Show the color picker dialog and wait for user selection.

HxColorDialog creates and shows a color picker dialog, then waits for the user to select a button. The selected color and button are returned.

If pTitle is set to NULL, the string "Choose Color" is used for the title bar of the dialog.

Parameters:
pTitle IN: Dialog title, or NULL
pColor IN/OUT: IN:Initial color, OUT: final selected color, if user selected the 'choose' button
pButton OUT: Index of the button that was selected
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK on success. Returns HX_FAILURE if the dialog could not be opened.
